# The process dies while the project gate of a round item runs. Someone removes the worktree and the base moves while no run is alive.
# The next run resumes the gate, which makes the worktree again at the commit that the run started on before it runs, not at the new tip of the base.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start
exec git -C origin checkout -q -b integration/r1
exec git -C origin add BASE_MARKER .gitignore
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C origin checkout -q main

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
# The script tests the round, not the sandbox, so its project keeps the sandbox off, though the fixture project file sets it on.
replace config/projects/local.star 'sandbox = "on"' 'sandbox = "off"'
replace config/projects/local.star '"make check"' '"sh '$WORK'/gate.sh"'
subst gate.sh
subst flow/round.star

exec beehestreal item add local round/integration/r1 --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

rm state/trees/local/round_2Fintegration_2Fr1
exec git -C origin checkout -q integration/r1
exec git -C origin add MOVED_MARKER
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m moved
exec git -C origin checkout -q main
exec git -C origin rev-parse integration/r1
cp stdout new-tip
cp body.txt second

exec beehestreal run round/integration/r1 local --workflow flow/round.star
stdout 'item round/integration/r1 finished'

# The gate ran again in the worktree at the start commit of the run, and the tree holds no commit of the moved base.
cmp second.head first.head
! cmp second.head new-tip
grep '^absent$' second.moved
grep '^passed$' result

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- origin/.gitignore --
reports/
-- gate.sh --
mkdir -p reports
echo '<testsuite name="g" tests="1"><testcase classname="g" name="t"/></testsuite>' > reports/g.xml
if [ -e @WORK@/second ]; then
	git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/second.head
	if [ -e MOVED_MARKER ]; then echo present > @WORK@/second.moved; else echo absent > @WORK@/second.moved; fi
else
	git rev-parse HEAD > @WORK@/first.head
	echo x > @WORK@/started
	sleep 20
fi
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    result = gate(name = "g")
    command(name = "record", run = ["sh", "-c", "echo " + ("passed" if result.passed else "failed") + " > @WORK@/result"])
